product.title: Brooklyn Bridge Waterfront Guided Bike Tour
product.description: Pedal from Lower Manhattan into Brooklyn with a local guide on a route that links riverfront parks, historic bridge crossings, and neighborhood viewpoints. This small-group ride combines skyline photo stops, local history, and a manageable pace suitable for travelers who want an active city overview without planning the route themselves.
highlights: Ride from Manhattan to Brooklyn on a guided waterfront bike route
Stop for skyline views from the Brooklyn Bridge and East River parks
See DUMBO, Brooklyn Heights, and working waterfront landmarks
Bike and helmet are included for a streamlined departure

start.description: Meeting point details are provided after booking in Lower Manhattan, New York City.

end.description: Returns to the original meeting point.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
Travelers should have a moderate physical fitness level

itineraryItems.title: City Hall Area
itineraryItems.description: Begin with a quick orientation ride near City Hall before heading toward the bridge.

itineraryItems.title: Brooklyn Bridge
itineraryItems.description: Cross the bridge with stops for East River and Lower Manhattan skyline photo opportunities.

itineraryItems.title: Brooklyn Heights Promenade
itineraryItems.description: Pause for views across the harbor and discuss the history of Brooklyn's waterfront neighborhoods.

itineraryItems.title: Brooklyn Bridge Park
itineraryItems.description: Ride through the expansive waterfront park and continue along the shoreline paths.

itineraryItems.title: DUMBO
itineraryItems.description: Explore cobblestone streets and converted warehouse blocks in one of Brooklyn's iconic districts.

itineraryItems.title: Brooklyn Navy Yard
itineraryItems.description: Finish with context on the working docks and industrial history that shaped the East River waterfront.
